description.value: Parthenon Market is a Greek and Mediterranean specialty grocery store that has anchored Kitsilano's Greek Town since 1967, stocking imported olive oils, olives, fetas, legumes, and pantry staples not commonly found elsewhere in Vancouver. The store relocated across the street in 2019 and expanded its offerings to include a Grab & Go deli counter with freshly prepared Mediterranean meals made daily. A touring cyclist stopping here will find a genuine neighbourhood institution with a wide range of packaged groceries and ready-to-eat options.
